Apricot Chicken Salad
By: Anonymous
Published: Sunday, December 13, 2009 - 12:15am

Ingredients




2 cups diced chicken or turkey
1 1/2 cups diced puffed apricots
1/2 cup diced celery (+ a little green onion)
1 1/2 tablespoons lime juice
1 (3 oz.) pkg. cream cheese
1 teaspoon salt
white pepper to taste
1/4 cup lite mayonnaise
1/4 cup sour cream

Preparation

1 Can use naval oranges instead of puffed apricots. 2 Cook chicken. Combine chicken, apricots, celery and green onion. Mix together lime juice, cream cheese, salt, pepper, mayonnaise and sour cream until smooth. Add chicken mixture. Chill well. Serves 6.
